item.name: Get employees with pagination and filtering
Retrieve details for a single employee

graphql.query:
mutation {
  createEmployee(input: {
    employeeId: "EMP006"
    name: "avinash p6"
    age: 32
    class: "Senior"
    subjects: ["Mathematics", "Physics"]
    department: "Engineering"
    position: "Software Engineer"
    salary: 175000
    email: "test6.p@example.com"
    phone: "+123456789"
    address: "123 test address"
  }) {
    id
    employeeId
    name
    age
    class
    subjects
    department
    position
    salary
    email
    phone
    address
    dateOfJoining
    isActive
  }
}
